_about: Measured 24sep2026 with StataNow 19.5 (console, batch) on sysuse auto (lo = price - 1000, hi = price + 1000): each graph is drawn with nodraw and every plot's style is read from .Graph.plotregion1.plot<k>.style (line.color.setting, marker.fillcolor.setting, marker.symbol.setting, line.width.setting, marker.linestyle.width.setting).  A ci fit (lfitci, qfitci, lpolyci, fpfitci) draws two plots, its band (pstyle ci) and then its line; twoway_lfitci_parse.class gives the line seriesid(`seriesid'-1), and a seriesid of 0 is drawn as p1.  So a layer that is plot n of the graph draws in p((n-1) mod 15 + 1), and a ci layer whose line is plot n in p(((n-1) mod 15 + 1) - 1), p1 where that is 0.  'layers' are dash's plot entries (one per y variable); 'pstyle' is the 1-based p# each layer's p#-styled plot was drawn in (for a ci layer, its line), identified by its colour against the scheme's p1-p15 colours and, for 'z1', by its width under #include s2color, linewidth p1 vthick, p14 thick, p15 vvthick.
_cases_note: An 'N*scatter' entry is N scatter layers whose pstyles are 1..N cycling through 15 (measured, not listed); 'pstyle' then lists only the layers after them.
